messages:
luisa: Heads-up — released community-evals-toolkit v0.1-alpha to GH 🎉

luisa: repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-evals-toolkit

luisa: what it is: lightweight CLI + runner, Redwood adapters for hosted/dedicated/private (set REDWOOD_API_URL + REDWOOD_API_KEY), a sample CI workflow, and a small set of curated eval suites (classification, summarization, safety).

ops-bot: release-bot published community-evals-toolkit v0.1-alpha — artifacts: CLI, metrics (EM, ROUGE, chrF), redwood-adapter, GitHub Action.

grant: nice. is there a doc for Private/on-prem setup? any gotchas with certs or internal routing?

luisa: short section in README under "Private & On-Prem" — you must point REDWOOD_API_URL to your control plane endpoint and use a service token; cert trust handled via system CA bundle. File an issue if you hit a peculiar env.

maya: would love a webhook or integration so eval runs show up in Console as a panel.

alex: I can prototype a webhook that posts results to /internal/eval-ingest; will need infra perms.

remy: CONTRIBUTING? need explicit dataset-licensing and PII checks before accepting prompt sets.

luisa: yes — CONTRIBUTING.md includes a dataset license checklist and a minimal PII/privacy checklist. Please open PRs for missing checks.

grant: default config supports pluggable metrics via Python hooks; planning BLEURT and BERTScore plugins next.

ops-bot: CI: build/test passed on main for v0.1-alpha.

maya: scheduling a 20-min maintainer onboarding Wed 11:00 PT to demo runner + config. DM me to join.

luisa: thanks everyone. we'll post release notes on the community forum and a short blog tomorrow. Reply here if you want maintainer access or to help curate eval suites. :rocket:
